notes.title: Patch 1.05 | HDR Hotfix
notes.notes:
We just pushed a hotfix to HDR compatibility. This hotfix addresses two issues, one stemming from compatibility with color blindness adjustment, and another related to certain UI elements corrupting the in-game image.

If you run into further problems with HDR compatibility after downloading this update, please reach out to us at myrkur@myrkur.is with your issue.

notes.title: Patch 1.05
notes.notes:
Patch 1.05 is now live on all platforms, bringing a number of fixes and smaller updates to the player experience. Check out the full patch notes below, and keep the feedback coming!




Meanwhile, the team is working towards a substantial update that we’re very excited to share with you all in the near future. Keep your eyes open for more information on that, coming soon!

notes.title: Patch 1.04
notes.notes:
We've just published Patch 1.04 which brings forward highly requested features including HDR support, chapter select and toggles to hints. In addition, by popular request, we've also reduced the damage taken from enemies for story mode. 

We've also fixed a number of defects reported to us. We are continuing to monitor your feedback and plan to release a bigger update in the coming weeks!

See you in Aema!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650707/39bdeeec740463b8727b0c47432c5c97d041ca28.jpg"]

notes.title: Update - Patch 1.03 is Live
notes.notes:
We've just published Patch 1.03, which brings forward an array of fixes for reported issues, as well as some smaller overall improvements.

Meanwhile, we continue working on a larger set of updates and quality of life features coming in next week. We had aimed to have HDR added to all hardware with this patch, but had to delay it to next week due to some incorrect interactions between HDR and colour-blind settings.

We will also be sharing a roadmap very soon to provide you with a good overview of the incoming updates and improvements ahead, incorporating your feedback and suggestions.

In the meantime, see you in Aema!

notes.title: Update - Combat improvements and patch notes
notes.notes:
Tomorrow marks ten days since we released Echoes of the End, and what a whirlwind it’s been! We’ve been absolutely thrilled with the support and reception we’ve received so far, but make no mistake, we’re listening to your feedback, too, and this patch, now live, is the biggest we’ve done yet. 

This update includes some considerable improvements to combat to make it feel more fluid and responsive, including the ability to cancel out of attacks into a dodge or parry, and some changes to how the camera and slow motion effects react to your actions.

You can check out the full patch notes below (minor spoiler alert), and keep your eyes peeled for a video going into more detail on some of these changes on our YouTube channel very soon!

notes.title: Update - Patch and combat update coming on Thursday
notes.notes:
Tomorrow marks a week since the launch of Echoes of the End, but that doesn’t mean we’ve been resting on our laurels! After last week's updates, the team has been hard at work reviewing more of your feedback on combat and other issues you've encountered since launch, and we’ll be rolling out two more updates this week in response.

The first, coming [strike]tomorrow[/strike] (please refer to the update at the bottom of the post), focuses on stability and polish, fixing several crashes, soft locks, and other technical issues players have reported, such as missing terrain on certain hardware. You can expect improvements to a few of our boss encounters as well, with Skuggi in particular receiving balance tweaks (as well as a fix to a rare bug causing players to not receive a skill point upon defeating him), and Zara’s shield gaining clearer visuals and sound effects to communicate its function to the player. Additional improvements include more forgiving dodge timing, larger subtitles, and some chapter-specific fixes to prevent unintended skips or progression blocks. 

Full patch notes will follow when the patch releases tomorrow, but the changes to dodge timing in particular are the first step in a more thorough combat update arriving on Thursday, that we believe will go far to address some of the issues players have been reporting there.

Alongside these updates, we're looking into other areas that matter to you guys (such as fixes to ultrawide cutscenes, HDR and DLSS framegen), and will keep you updated on each of these as we move forward.

Thanks for all of your support so far, and we hope you continue to enjoy Ryn's story as we keep working to improve your experience with the game.

UPDATE: We were unfortunately not able to test the patch for today (Tuesday) to a point where we were satisfied with pushing it out to the public. Instead of risking a patch that may introduce further issues, we are combining it with Thursday's larger combat update. We thank you for the understanding and support you've shown so far, and hope you will continue to enjoy your journeys through Aema as we continue to work to improve your experience with Echoes of the End.

notes.title: Update - A fix to shader-related stuttering
notes.notes:
As we mentioned in our patch notes yesterday, we've been hard at work implementing and testing a fix to the shader precompilation issues that have caused some players to experience hitches and stuttering during gameplay, especially in the game's earlier chapters. Today's update (which is now live!) should go far to address these issues, but we encourage you to let us know if you still encounter hitches during gameplay after updating. 



Thank you all once again for all your support, and we hope you continue to enjoy your time in Aema!

notes.notes:

You can expect another patch coming tomorrow addressing the shader precompilation issues that have been causing visual hitches for some players, in particular in the game's earliest chapters.



Check out the full patch notes below!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650707/a0acae6dbaecf550a5c1ca372cf0dcc5fc0a3b98.png"]

notes.title: Update - Patch tomorrow and performance fixes Friday
notes.notes:
It’s been a busy couple of days here at the Myrkur Games studio, and we want to start by thanking you all for the incredible support you’ve shown the game! As we mentioned in our last post, we’ve been keeping a close eye on the performance issues some players have reported, particularly hitches and stutters in the PC build caused by shaders not being captured correctly for precompilation. We have found the source of the problem, which should address stutter issues caused by shaders being compiled during play.

Tomorrow we’ll be implementing and testing these changes, and we’re confident we can deliver them to you on Friday, just in time for a smooth weekend of gaming. In the meantime, you can expect another patch tomorrow addressing several other reported issues.

Thank you again for joining us on this journey. We hope you continue to enjoy your time in Aema!

notes.title: Showcase - An update to combat animations
notes.notes:
It's been just about two weeks since the gameplay trailer dropped and we've been absolutely thrilled to see the response so far! We want to thank you all for watching and taking the time to comment, and to show you that we’re taking your feedback seriously as we polish our way to release.



Many of you wanted to see combat feel faster and more fluid, and we’ve been hard at work making that happen. We’re excited to share this look at some of the updates we've been doing to combat animations and we’ll make sure to keep refining and listening to your feedback right up until launch.


[previewyoutube="COrdG4hi41Y;full"][/previewyoutube]


We love hearing what you think, so please, keep the comments coming. And make sure you check back here tomorrow for another one of our semi-regular dev vlogs!



Echoes of the End releases August 12th. Wishlist the game now and follow this community hub for all the latest updates!
